## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of the change you would like to see. Include
instruction names, account layouts, or SDK signatures when relevant.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why did you pick this one?

## Impact

- Breaking change for existing integrations: yes or no
- Requires on chain program upgrade: yes or no
- Documentation updates needed: yes or no

## Additional context

Links to related issues, prior art in other Solana programs, references
to the relevant section of `docs/architecture.md`.
